# Youna Global

> Youna Global (Youna (Zhongshan) Commerce & Trade Co., Ltd.) is a B2B China sourcing agent based in Guangdong, China, serving importers, wholesalers and distributors in 20+ countries. We help global buyers buy directly from Chinese factories at factory prices, with verification, negotiation, quality control, OEM/private-label branding, warehousing and worldwide shipping.

## What we do
- Find and verify Chinese suppliers and factories
- Negotiate factory-direct prices on behalf of overseas buyers
- Quality control and factory audits before shipment
- OEM / private-label customization: packaging, color cards, brochures, warranty cards, branded tools
- Warehouse consolidation and worldwide shipping

## Core product categories
- Automotive supplies: paint protection film (PPF), color-change / vinyl wrap film, window film, light film (clear, matte, polycarbonate)
- Consumer electronics (incl. Bluetooth TWS earbuds)
- Apparel and accessories
- Pet supplies
- TikTok-trending products
- Custom OEM / private-label goods

## Why buy direct from China with Youna
- Overseas distributor channels are expensive; factory-direct sourcing through a local agent lowers landed cost.
- Example: automotive film that costs USD 1,000-2,000 via overseas channels can be sourced factory-direct from China, freight included, at a lower total cost.
- One local agent handles sourcing, QC, branding, consolidation and shipping end to end.
